editorial.blurb: Shattaz brings authentic Jamaican flavors and vibrant energy to Chicago, with jerk preparations and sides that earn serious devotion.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive well before their 10 PM closing time, and don't skip the cabbage and yams—reviewers rave these sides are show-stealers; the spicy sauce transforms even simple wings.

topDishes.note: Standout sides with complex spicy-mild flavor and perfect crunch
